...

# **About Standard Bots**
We're looking for an Electrical Engineering Manager to lead the team that owns the electronics at the heart of our robots: motor controllers, power distribution, compute, camera, battery management, and sensing boards. You will be accountable for the technical output of the entire electrical engineering team: the quality, schedule, and manufacturability of every board we design and release.

...

**Location**
This is an on-site role based at our Glen Cove, NY factory, where our robots are designed, built, and tested. On-site, you'll have a fully equipped electronics lab, production robots, and our manufacturing floor steps from your desk.
**Responsibilities**

...

* Experience: You have a bachelor's or graduate degree in Electrical Engineering (or a related field), 15+ years designing, building, and testing PCBAs, including designs you've taken through production release, and 7+ years leading and managing electrical engineers
* Leadership: You have hired, coached, and grown engineers, including early-career engineers; you set clear priorities, give direct feedback, and hold a high technical bar

...

The base salary range for this role is $180,000 to $230,000, depending on experience. Base salary is just one part of the overall compensation at Standard Bots. All Full-Time Employees are eligible for Employee Stock Options. We also offer a package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, and 401(k) to regular full-time employees.
